out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED FRONT HANDWASHING SINK WITHOUT SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL FACILITY A COPY OF SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED (OR THE FACILITY MAY POST THEIR OWN). PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.observation: OBSERVED MISSING CEILING TILES NEAR HOT WATER HEATER IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE PATCH THE CEILING TILES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
